/books/OL27184913M.description: "Tessa and Hardin have had enough surprises. Their bond is stronger than ever, but every new challenge they face shakes their foundation--and Hardin's impenetrable façade--to the core. As the shocking truth about each of their families emerges, it's clear the two lovers are not so different from each other. Tessa is no longer the sweet, simple, good girl she was when she met Hardin--any more than he is the cruel, moody boy she fell so hard for. Tessa understands all the troubling emotions brewing within Hardin, and she knows she's the only one who can calm him when he erupts. He needs her. But the more layers of his past that come to light, the darker he grows, and the harder he pushes Tessa--and everyone else in his life--away. After all this time, Tessa's not sure if she really can save him--not without sacrificing herself. Is love worth losing her identity? She refuses to go down without a fight. But who is she really fighting for--Hardin or herself?" -- p. [4] of cover

description.value: Morgana’s plane had been hijacked! Why? The treacherous landing in the foothills of the Andes had been frightening enough, but when Morgana alone was taken from the plane at gunpoint, sheer terror gripped her! Who were these men, and what did they want with her? And why did she feel that behind this lurked the mysterious Luis Salvador, a man she had met briefly at an embassy reception in Rio? He had struck her as being a passionate man — both politically and personally. Morgana wondered which side of him she was to encounter . . . .

description.value: At the Tycoon's Command is a passionate, emotional charged romance about power, desire, and the secrets that bind two people together. When commanding, self-made tycoon reenters the heroine's life, he brings with him unresolved tension, unfinished business, and an offer she can't easily refuse. Drawn back into his world of wealth and control, she must confront the past they shared-and the feelings she thought she had buried. As attraction reignites and old wounds resurface, both must decide whether their connection is built on possession or something far deeper. The Mills & Boon story delivers the signature blend of intensity, glamour, and heartfelt conflict that defines the line.

first_sentence.value: The book begins with the heroine confronting the powerful tycoon who once upended her life, immediately setting a tone of tension, unresolved emotion, and the sense that their past is about to collide with the present.
